paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation

model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between average lagging (AL) and BLEU score for several different configurations. The x-axis, labeled “Average Lagging (AL),” is a linear scale ranging from 2 to 8 with tick intervals of 1, and the units are not explicitly stated. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU,” is also a linear scale ranging from approximately 22 to 30 with tick intervals of 2.  A dashed purple line represents the Consistency-CE configuration, starting at approximately 22.5 and ending at approximately 28.7. A solid blue line represents the Inconsistency-CE configuration, beginning at approximately 22.0 and terminating at approximately 28.3. A dashed black line represents the Inconsistency-MP configuration, beginning at approximately 20.5 and ending at approximately 27.3. Finally, a red line represents the Consistency-Bi configuration, beginning at approximately 21.0 and ending at approximately 28.0.
